struct Value;
using Vec = std::vector<Value>;
using VecPtr = std::shared_ptr<Vec>;

struct Value {

    Data data{Special::Null};

    Value() = default;
    explicit Value(bool v):data(v){}
    explicit Value(std::int64_t v):data(v){}
    explicit Value(int v):data((std::int64_t)v){}
    explicit Value(double v):data(v){}
    explicit Value(std::complex<double> v):data(v){}
    explicit Value(const char* v):data(std::string(v)){}
    explicit Value(std::string v):data(std::move(v)){}
    explicit Value(Vec v):data(std::make_shared<Vec>(std::move(v))){}

    static Value null(){ Value v; v.data=Special::Null; return v; }
    static Value na(){ Value v; v.data=Special::NA; return v; }
    static Value missing(){ Value v; v.data=Special::Missing; return v; }

    bool is_special(Special s) const { auto p=std::get_if<Special>(&data); return p&&*p==s; }
    bool is_null() const { return is_special(Special::Null); }
    bool is_na() const { return is_special(Special::NA); }
    bool is_missing() const { return is_special(Special::Missing); }
    bool is_vec() const { return std::holds_alternative<VecPtr>(data); }

inline const Vec& as_vector_ref(const Value& v) {
    if (auto p=std::get_if<VecPtr>(&v.data)) return **p;
    throw std::runtime_error("value is not a vector");
}
inline Vec as_vector(const Value& v) {
    if (auto p=std::get_if<VecPtr>(&v.data)) return **p;
    return Vec{v};
}
inline std::size_t length_of(const Value& v){ return v.is_vec()?as_vector_ref(v).size():(v.is_null()?0:1); }

inline double number(const Value& v) {
    if(v.is_na()) return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&v.data))return(double)*p;
    if(auto p=std::get_if<double>(&v.data))return *p;
    if(auto p=std::get_if<bool>(&v.data))return *p?1.0:0.0;
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::complex<double>>(&v.data))return p->real();
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::string>(&v.data)){try{return std::stod(*p);}catch(...){return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();}}
    return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
}
inline std::int64_t integer(const Value& v){ return (std::int64_t)number(v); }
inline bool truth(const Value& v){
    if(v.is_na()||v.is_null()||v.is_missing())throw std::runtime_error("missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed");
    if(v.is_vec()){const auto& a=as_vector_ref(v);if(a.size()!=1)throw std::runtime_error("condition has length != 1");return truth(a[0]);}
    if(auto p=std::get_if<bool>(&v.data))return *p;
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&v.data))return *p!=0;
    if(auto p=std::get_if<double>(&v.data))return *p!=0.0&&!std::isnan(*p);
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::string>(&v.data))return !p->empty();
    return true;
}
inline std::string text(const Value& v){
    if(v.is_null())return "NULL"; if(v.is_na())return "NA"; if(v.is_missing())return "";
    if(auto p=std::get_if<bool>(&v.data))return *p?"TRUE":"FALSE";
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&v.data))return std::to_string(*p);
    if(auto p=std::get_if<double>(&v.data)){std::ostringstream s;s<<std::setprecision(15)<<*p;return s.str();}
    if(auto p=std::get_if<std::complex<double>>(&v.data)){std::ostringstream s;s<<p->real();if(p->imag()>=0)s<<"+";s<<p->imag()<<"i";return s.str();}

    return "";
}
inline void print(const Value& v){std::cout<<text(v)<<'\n';}

inline Value recycle_binary(const Value&a,const Value&b,const std::function<Value(const Value&,const Value&)>&f){
    if(!a.is_vec()&&!b.is_vec())return f(a,b);
    Vec av=as_vector(a),bv=as_vector(b);size_t n=std::max(av.size(),bv.size());Vec out;out.reserve(n);

    for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i)out.push_back(f(av[i%av.size()],bv[i%bv.size()]));

inline Value vector_unary(const Value&a,const std::function<Value(const Value&)>&f){

inline Value eq_scalar(const Value&a,const Value&b){if(a.is_na()||b.is_na())return Value::na();return Value(text(a)==text(b));}
inline Value binary(const std::string&op,const Value&a,const Value&b){
    if(op==":"){std::int64_t x=integer(a),y=integer(b),step=x<=y?1:-1;Vec out;for(std::int64_t i=x;;i+=step){out.emplace_back(i);if(i==y)break;}return Value(std::move(out));}
    if(op=="%in%"){Vec aa=as_vector(a),bb=as_vector(b),out;for(auto&x:aa){bool ok=false;for(auto&y:bb)if(text(eq_scalar(x,y))=="TRUE"){ok=true;break;}out.emplace_back(ok);}return Value(std::move(out));}
    if(op=="$"||op=="@")return Value::null();
    return recycle_binary(a,b,[&](const Value&x,const Value&y)->Value{
        if(x.is_na()||y.is_na())return Value::na();
        if(op=="+")return Value(number(x)+number(y));
        if(op=="-")return Value(number(x)-number(y));
        if(op=="*")return Value(number(x)*number(y));
        if(op=="/")return Value(number(x)/number(y));
        if(op=="^"||op=="**")return Value(std::pow(number(x),number(y)));
        if(op=="%%")return Value(std::fmod(number(x),number(y)));
        if(op=="%/%")return Value((std::int64_t)std::floor(number(x)/number(y)));
        if(op=="==")return eq_scalar(x,y);
        if(op=="!="){auto q=eq_scalar(x,y);return q.is_na()?q:Value(!truth(q));}
        if(op=="<")return Value(number(x)<number(y)); if(op=="<=")return Value(number(x)<=number(y));
        if(op==">")return Value(number(x)>number(y)); if(op==">=")return Value(number(x)>=number(y));
        if(op=="&"||op=="&&")return Value(truth(x)&&truth(y));
        if(op=="|"||op=="||")return Value(truth(x)||truth(y));
        throw std::runtime_error("unsupported binary operator: "+op);
    });
}
inline Value unary(const std::string&op,const Value&a){
    return vector_unary(a,[&](const Value&x)->Value{if(x.is_na())return Value::na();if(op=="-")return Value(-number(x));if(op=="+")return Value(number(x));if(op=="!")return Value(!truth(x));if(op=="~")return x;throw std::runtime_error("unsupported unary operator: "+op);});

inline Value arg(const std::vector<NamedArg>&a,const std::string&name,size_t pos,Value def=Value::missing()){

inline Value subset(const Value&x,std::initializer_list<NamedArg> ai,bool dbl){

        {"debugOnOff","runtime"},
        {"La_qr_cmplx","matrix"},
        {"La_rs","matrix"},
        {"La_rs_cmplx","matrix"},
        {"La_rg","matrix"},
        {"La_rg_cmplx","matrix"},
        {"La_dlange","matrix"},

    };
    auto it=m.find(name);return it==m.end()?std::string():it->second;
}

inline std::mt19937_64& rng(){static std::mt19937_64 g{5489u};return g;}
inline Value map_numeric(const Value&v,const std::function<double(double)>&f){return vector_unary(v,[&](const Value&x){return x.is_na()?Value::na():Value(f(number(x)));});}
inline Value reduce_num(const Value&v,const std::string&kind,bool na_rm=false){
    Vec a=as_vector(v);std::vector<double>z;for(auto&x:a){double q=number(x);if(std::isnan(q)){if(na_rm)continue;return Value::na();}z.push_back(q);}
    if(kind=="sum")return Value(std::accumulate(z.begin(),z.end(),0.0));
    if(kind=="prod")return Value(std::accumulate(z.begin(),z.end(),1.0,std::multiplies<double>()));
    if(z.empty())return Value::na();
    if(kind=="mean")return Value(std::accumulate(z.begin(),z.end(),0.0)/z.size());
    if(kind=="min")return Value(*std::min_element(z.begin(),z.end()));
    if(kind=="max")return Value(*std::max_element(z.begin(),z.end()));
    return Value::na();
}
inline Value cumulative(const Value&v,const std::string&kind){Vec a=as_vector(v),o;double acc=(kind=="cumprod"?1.0:0.0);for(auto&x:a){double q=number(x);if(kind=="cumsum")acc+=q;else if(kind=="cumprod")acc*=q;else if(kind=="cummin")acc=o.empty()?q:std::min(number(o.back()),q);else if(kind=="cummax")acc=o.empty()?q:std::max(number(o.back()),q);o.emplace_back(acc);}return Value(std::move(o));}
inline bool named_bool(const std::vector<NamedArg>&a,const std::string&n,bool d=false){auto v=arg(a,n,999,Value(d));return v.is_missing()?d:truth(v);}

inline Value call(const std::string&name,std::initializer_list<NamedArg> ai){
    std::vector<NamedArg>a(ai);auto p=positional(a);
    auto A=[&](size_t i,Value d=Value::missing()){return i<p.size()?p[i]:d;};

    if(name=="print"||name=="show"){auto v=A(0,Value::null());print(v);return v;}
    if(name=="identity"||name=="invisible"||name=="force"||name=="forceAndCall")return A(0,Value::null());
    if(name=="c"||name=="list"||name=="expression"){Vec out;for(auto&x:a){if(x.value.is_vec()&&name=="c"){for(auto&y:as_vector_ref(x.value))out.push_back(y);}else if(!x.value.is_missing())out.push_back(x.value);}return Value(std::move(out));}
    if(name=="length"||name=="lengths")return Value((std::int64_t)length_of(A(0)));
    if(name=="sum"||name=="prod"||name=="mean"||name=="min"||name=="max")return reduce_num(A(0),name,named_bool(a,"na.rm"));
    if(name=="range"){Value lo=reduce_num(A(0),"min",named_bool(a,"na.rm")),hi=reduce_num(A(0),"max",named_bool(a,"na.rm"));return Value(Vec{lo,hi});}
    if(name=="abs")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::abs(x);});
    if(name=="sqrt")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::sqrt(x);});
    if(name=="exp")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::exp(x);});
    if(name=="expm1")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::expm1(x);});
    if(name=="log")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::log(x);});
    if(name=="log10")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::log10(x);});
    if(name=="log2")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::log2(x);});
    if(name=="log1p")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::log1p(x);});
    if(name=="sin")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::sin(x);});
    if(name=="cos")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::cos(x);});
    if(name=="tan")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::tan(x);});
    if(name=="asin")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::asin(x);});
    if(name=="acos")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::acos(x);});
    if(name=="atan")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::atan(x);});
    if(name=="sinh")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::sinh(x);});
    if(name=="cosh")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::cosh(x);});
    if(name=="tanh")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::tanh(x);});
    if(name=="floor")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::floor(x);});
    if(name=="ceiling")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::ceil(x);});
    if(name=="trunc")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::trunc(x);});
    if(name=="round")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::round(x);});
    if(name=="sign")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return x<0?-1.0:x>0?1.0:0.0;});
    if(name=="gamma")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::tgamma(x);});
    if(name=="lgamma")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return std::lgamma(x);});
    if(name=="cumsum"||name=="cumprod"||name=="cummin"||name=="cummax")return cumulative(A(0),name);
    if(name=="diff"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0)),o;for(size_t i=1;i<x.size();++i)o.push_back(binary("-",x[i],x[i-1]));return Value(std::move(o));}

    if(name=="is.na")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(x.is_na()||(std::holds_alternative<double>(x.data)&&std::isnan(std::get<double>(x.data))));});
    if(name=="is.nan")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(std::holds_alternative<double>(x.data)&&std::isnan(std::get<double>(x.data)));});
    if(name=="is.finite")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(std::isfinite(number(x)));});
    if(name=="is.infinite")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(std::isinf(number(x)));});
    if(name=="is.null")return Value(A(0).is_null());
    if(name=="is.logical")return Value(std::holds_alternative<bool>(A(0).data));
    if(name=="is.integer")return Value(std::holds_alternative<std::int64_t>(A(0).data));
    if(name=="is.double"||name=="is.numeric")return Value(std::holds_alternative<double>(A(0).data)||std::holds_alternative<std::int64_t>(A(0).data));
    if(name=="is.character")return Value(std::holds_alternative<std::string>(A(0).data));
    if(name=="is.list"||name=="is.vector"||name=="is.atomic")return Value(A(0).is_vec());

    if(name=="as.double"||name=="as.numeric"||name=="as.real")return map_numeric(A(0),[](double x){return x;});
    if(name=="as.integer")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value((std::int64_t)number(x));});
    if(name=="as.logical")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(truth(x));});
    if(name=="as.character")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(text(x));});
    if(name=="as.list"||name=="as.vector")return Value(as_vector(A(0)));

    if(name=="sort"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::sort(x.begin(),x.end(),[](auto&u,auto&v){return number(u)<number(v);});return Value(std::move(x));}
    if(name=="rev"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::reverse(x.begin(),x.end());return Value(std::move(x));}
    if(name=="unique"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0)),o;std::set<std::string>s;for(auto&v:x)if(s.insert(text(v)).second)o.push_back(v);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="which"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0)),o;for(size_t i=0;i<x.size();++i)if(!x[i].is_na()&&truth(x[i]))o.emplace_back((std::int64_t)i+1);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="which.min"||name=="which.max"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));if(x.empty())return Value((std::int64_t)0);size_t bi=0;for(size_t i=1;i<x.size();++i)if((name=="which.min"?number(x[i])<number(x[bi]):number(x[i])>number(x[bi])))bi=i;return Value((std::int64_t)bi+1);}
    if(name=="order"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0)),o;std::vector<size_t>ix(x.size());std::iota(ix.begin(),ix.end(),0);std::stable_sort(ix.begin(),ix.end(),[&](size_t i,size_t j){return number(x[i])<number(x[j]);});for(auto i:ix)o.emplace_back((std::int64_t)i+1);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="rank"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::vector<std::pair<double,size_t>>z;for(size_t i=0;i<x.size();++i)z.push_back({number(x[i]),i});std::stable_sort(z.begin(),z.end());Vec o(x.size());for(size_t r=0;r<z.size();++r)o[z[r].second]=Value((double)r+1);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="match"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0)),tab=as_vector(A(1)),o;for(auto&v:x){std::int64_t hit=0;for(size_t j=0;j<tab.size();++j)if(truth(eq_scalar(v,tab[j]))){hit=(std::int64_t)j+1;break;}o.emplace_back(hit?Value(hit):Value::na());}return Value(std::move(o));}

    if(name=="seq_len"){std::int64_t n=integer(A(0));Vec o;for(std::int64_t i=1;i<=n;++i)o.emplace_back(i);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="seq_along"){std::int64_t n=(std::int64_t)length_of(A(0));Vec o;for(std::int64_t i=1;i<=n;++i)o.emplace_back(i);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="seq"||name=="seq.int"){double from=number(A(0,Value(1.0))),to=number(A(1,A(0))),by=number(arg(a,"by",2,Value(1.0)));Vec o;if(by==0)throw std::runtime_error("invalid by");if((by>0&&from<=to)||(by<0&&from>=to))for(double x=from;(by>0?x<=to+1e-12:x>=to-1e-12);x+=by)o.emplace_back(x);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="rep"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::int64_t times=integer(arg(a,"times",1,Value((std::int64_t)1)));Vec o;for(std::int64_t t=0;t<times;++t)o.insert(o.end(),x.begin(),x.end());return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="head"||name=="tail"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::int64_t n=integer(A(1,Value((std::int64_t)6)));n=std::max<std::int64_t>(0,std::min<std::int64_t>(n,(std::int64_t)x.size()));if(name=="head")x.resize((size_t)n);else x=Vec(x.end()-n,x.end());return Value(std::move(x));}

    if(name=="paste"||name=="paste0"){std::string sep=name=="paste"?" ":"";auto sv=arg(a,"sep",999,Value(sep));if(!sv.is_missing())sep=text(sv);std::string out;for(size_t i=0;i<p.size();++i){if(i)out+=sep;out+=text(p[i]);}return Value(out);}
    if(name=="nchar")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value((std::int64_t)text(x).size());});
    if(name=="toupper"||name=="tolower")return vector_unary(A(0),[&](const Value&x){auto s=text(x);for(char&c:s)c=name=="toupper"?(char)std::toupper((unsigned char)c):(char)std::tolower((unsigned char)c);return Value(s);});
    if(name=="substr"||name=="substring"){auto s=text(A(0));auto st=std::max<std::int64_t>(1,integer(A(1)))-1;auto en=integer(A(2,Value((std::int64_t)s.size())));if((size_t)st>=s.size())return Value("");return Value(s.substr((size_t)st,(size_t)std::max<std::int64_t>(0,en-st)));}
    if(name=="grepl"||name=="grep"){std::regex re(text(A(0)));Vec x=as_vector(A(1)),o;for(size_t i=0;i<x.size();++i){bool m=std::regex_search(text(x[i]),re);if(name=="grepl")o.emplace_back(m);else if(m)o.emplace_back((std::int64_t)i+1);}return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="sub"||name=="gsub"){std::regex re(text(A(0)));auto repl=text(A(1));return vector_unary(A(2),[&](const Value&x){auto s=text(x);return Value(std::regex_replace(s,re,repl,name=="sub"?std::regex_constants::format_first_only:std::regex_constants::match_default));});}

    if(name=="matrix"){Value v=A(0,Value(Vec{}));std::int64_t nr=integer(arg(a,"nrow",1,Value((std::int64_t)1))),nc=integer(arg(a,"ncol",2,Value((std::int64_t)0)));Vec src=as_vector(v);if(nc==0)nc=nr?std::max<std::int64_t>(1,(std::int64_t)std::ceil(src.size()/(double)nr)):0;Vec o;size_t n=(size_t)std::max<std::int64_t>(0,nr*nc);for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i)o.push_back(src.empty()?Value::na():src[i%src.size()]);Value z(o);z.dim={(size_t)nr,(size_t)nc};return z;}
    if(name=="dim"){Vec o;for(auto d:A(0).dim)o.emplace_back((std::int64_t)d);return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="nrow")return Value((std::int64_t)(A(0).dim.size()>=1?A(0).dim[0]:length_of(A(0))));
    if(name=="ncol")return Value((std::int64_t)(A(0).dim.size()>=2?A(0).dim[1]:1));
    if(name=="t"){Value z=A(0);if(z.dim.size()!=2)return z;auto src=as_vector(z);size_t nr=z.dim[0],nc=z.dim[1];Vec o(src.size());for(size_t r=0;r<nr;++r)for(size_t c=0;c<nc;++c)o[c+nc*r]=src[r+nr*c];z=Value(o);z.dim={nc,nr};return z;}
    if(name=="rowSums"||name=="colSums"){auto z=A(0);auto src=as_vector(z);if(z.dim.size()!=2)return reduce_num(z,"sum");size_t nr=z.dim[0],nc=z.dim[1];Vec o(name=="rowSums"?nr:nc,Value(0.0));if(name=="rowSums"){for(size_t r=0;r<nr;++r){double s=0;for(size_t c=0;c<nc;++c)s+=number(src[r+nr*c]);o[r]=Value(s);}}else{for(size_t c=0;c<nc;++c){double s=0;for(size_t r=0;r<nr;++r)s+=number(src[r+nr*c]);o[c]=Value(s);}}return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="diag"){auto z=A(0);if(z.dim.size()!=2){std::int64_t n=integer(z);Vec o((size_t)(n*n),Value(0.0));for(std::int64_t i=0;i<n;++i)o[(size_t)(i+n*i)]=Value(1.0);Value q(o);q.dim={(size_t)n,(size_t)n};return q;}auto src=as_vector(z);size_t n=std::min(z.dim[0],z.dim[1]);Vec o;for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i)o.push_back(src[i+z.dim[0]*i]);return Value(std::move(o));}

    if(name=="any"||name=="all"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));bool v=name=="all";for(auto&q:x){if(q.is_na())continue;if(name=="any")v=v||truth(q);else v=v&&truth(q);}return Value(v);}
    if(name=="pmin"||name=="pmax"){return recycle_binary(A(0),A(1),[&](const Value&x,const Value&y){return Value(name=="pmin"?std::min(number(x),number(y)):std::max(number(x),number(y)));});}

    if(name=="set.seed"){rng().seed((std::uint64_t)integer(A(0)));return Value::null();}
    if(name=="runif"){std::int64_t n=integer(A(0));double lo=number(A(1,Value(0.0))),hi=number(A(2,Value(1.0)));std::uniform_real_distribution<double>d(lo,hi);Vec o;for(std::int64_t i=0;i<n;++i)o.emplace_back(d(rng()));return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="rnorm"){std::int64_t n=integer(A(0));double mu=number(A(1,Value(0.0))),sd=number(A(2,Value(1.0)));std::normal_distribution<double>d(mu,sd);Vec o;for(std::int64_t i=0;i<n;++i)o.emplace_back(d(rng()));return Value(std::move(o));}
    if(name=="sample"){Vec x=as_vector(A(0));std::shuffle(x.begin(),x.end(),rng());std::int64_t n=integer(A(1,Value((std::int64_t)x.size())));if((size_t)n<x.size())x.resize((size_t)n);return Value(std::move(x));}

    if(name=="getwd")return Value(std::filesystem::current_path().string());
    if(name=="setwd"){std::filesystem::current_path(text(A(0)));return Value::null();}
    if(name=="file.exists")return vector_unary(A(0),[](const Value&x){return Value(std::filesystem::exists(text(x)));});
    if(name=="dir.create"){return Value(std::filesystem::create_directories(text(A(0)))||std::filesystem::exists(text(A(0))));}
    if(name=="unlink"||name=="file.remove"){return Value((bool)std::filesystem::remove(text(A(0))));}
    if(name=="Sys.getenv"){const char*q=std::getenv(text(A(0)).c_str());return Value(q?std::string(q):std::string());}
    if(name=="Sys.time"){auto n=std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch();return Value(std::chrono::duration<double>(n).count());}
    if(name=="Sys.Date"){auto n=std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch();return Value(std::floor(std::chrono::duration<double>(n).count()/86400.0));}

    if(name=="stop")throw std::runtime_error(text(A(0,Value("R stop"))));
    if(name=="warning"){std::cerr<<"Warning: "<<text(A(0))<<'\n';return Value::null();}
    if(name=="typeof"){auto v=A(0);if(v.is_null())return Value("NULL");if(v.is_vec())return Value("list");if(std::holds_alternative<bool>(v.data))return Value("logical");if(std::holds_alternative<std::int64_t>(v.data))return Value("integer");if(std::holds_alternative<double>(v.data))return Value("double");if(std::holds_alternative<std::complex<double>>(v.data))return Value("complex");if(std::holds_alternative<std::string>(v.data))return Value("character");return Value("unknown");}
    if(name=="class")return call("typeof",{NamedArg{"",A(0)}});

    // Every primitive in the 702-entry matrix has a kernel route. Exact handlers
    // above cover the common executable semantics; rare/stateful primitives are
    // deliberately explicit instead of silently producing wrong results.
    const auto k=kernel_of(name);
    if(!k.empty())throw std::runtime_error("R primitive '"+name+"' is routed to C++ kernel '"+k+"' but its exact edge semantics are not implemented yet");
    throw std::runtime_error("unknown R function: "+name);
}
inline Value call_value(const Value&,std::initializer_list<NamedArg>){throw std::runtime_error("indirect function values are not implemented");}

} // namespace r2cpp
